title: Vane
subtitle: Quarrelsome Pirate
text: Action [Exhaust, defeat a friendly upgrade]: Deal 2 damage to a base.
deployBox: On Attack: You may defeat a friendly upgrade. If you do, deal 2 damage to the defending unit or a base.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: A friendly upgrade is any upgrade you put into play or any token upgrade on a friendly unit.
